notes: 2026-09-12 (ENGINE_GAPS.md gap #13, real closure): Traveling Chocobo's own "If a land or Bird you control entering the battlefield causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time" is now real, general engine machinery (`card.ts`'s new `triggerDoubling`, a new shared `functional-model/triggers.ts`'s `fireTrigger`, `state.ts`'s new `shouldDoubleTrigger`) — the SAME mechanism Cloud, Midgar Mercenary and The Masamune also needed, built once and shared. `definition.ts` now declares `triggerDoubling: [{ scope: 'anyPermanentYouControl', causedBy: 'entersBattlefield', entersMatch: [{isLand:true},{subtype:'Bird'}] }]` (replacing the old documentary-only `staticAbilities` string for this one clause; the other two real abilities — look at the top card any time / play lands and cast Bird spells from the top of your library — stay `staticAbilities` text, no representable mechanism/out of scope respectively). `runEngineScenarios()` replaced the old "no resolvable effect" placeholder with a real demonstration reusing Ambrosia Whiteheart (a real FIN card already modeled with a real Landfall trigger, `cards/ambrosia-whiteheart/definition.ts`) — a real land later enters the battlefield, Ambrosia's own `onLandfall` trigger fires manually (same real "no auto-detection for a reactive trigger" pattern that card's own standalone scenario already establishes) with a real `{kind:'entersBattlefield', entered:<the real land>}` cause, genuinely doubling (Ambrosia gets +1/+0 TWICE) since Chocobo's own `entersMatch` gate is checked against the real entering object's own type, not just presence. Real, GENUINELY UNPLANNED but textually correct consequence, found running the scenario rather than designed in and kept rather than avoided: Ambrosia Whiteheart is HERSELF a Bird, so her own ETB (fired via `engine.ts`'s own real auto-dispatch, which now threads the same `entersBattlefield` cause through `fireTrigger`) ALSO doubles — bouncing two of the caster's own real basic lands instead of one. This is the first real trace in the pool showing a card's own ETB double itself via a board-wide Panharmonicon-style grant, not a bug. `run-scenarios.mjs --slug=traveling-chocobo`: regenerated trace.json, 1 scenario, engine-piloted. No synergy.json change this pass — this card's own existing fact (a bare Battlefield-presence source) is unrelated to this clause; whether a new fact for the doubling effect itself is worth authoring is a synergy-authoring question left open, not decided here. New unit tests: `functional-model/triggers.test.ts`'s own `Traveling Chocobo's own gate` describe block (4 cases: doubles for a land cause, doubles for a Bird-subtype cause, does NOT double for a non-land/non-Bird cause, does NOT double an opponent's own permanent). `vitest run functional-model`: 340/340.
